steps.description: The person holds the drill with both hands and slides the battery pack off the base, placing it on the table.
steps.title: Remove the battery pack

steps.description: The person loosens the chuck by hand and pulls the old bit out of the drill, then sets it down on the table.
steps.title: Remove the old drill bit

steps.description: The person opens the bit case on the side table and picks out a new drill bit with the fingers.
steps.title: Select a new drill bit

steps.description: The person inserts the new bit into the chuck and twists the chuck tight to secure it.
steps.title: Install the new drill bit

steps.description: The person picks up the battery pack and slides it back onto the base of the drill until seated.
steps.title: Reattach the battery pack

task_summary: Change the drill bit on a cordless electric drill by disconnecting power, swapping the bit, and reconnecting power.
